Colleges nationwide have participated in the National Study of Learning, Voting, and Engagement (NSLVE), which compels institutions to hand over students' FERPA-protected data. 

This data is then shared through the National Student Clearinghouse (NSC) with third-party voter processing companies. 

Without student consent, these companies match student information with voter databases.
